description:
Prepare a search_trips option on daytrip.com and return a link where the traveler finishes the booking themselves. Nothing is charged and no personal data is needed: on the link the traveler enters their name, email and phone, optional pickup address and flight number, and pays.

Use this when the traveler prefers to finish on the website, or when book_trip is not available to you. It does not create a booking.

Returns one of:
- status "handover": give handoverUrl to the traveler and tell them to open it, complete their details and pay. summary describes the trip; the quoted price is held until expiresAt (the link keeps working afterwards, but the price may be re-quoted).
- status "price_changed" (PRICE_CHANGED): the price moved since the search. Tell the traveler the new price; if they accept, call get_booking_link again with the returned offerId.
- status "offer_expired" (OFFER_EXPIRED): call search_trips again and offer the fresh options.
- status "route_not_available" (ROUTE_NOT_AVAILABLE): the trip can no longer be booked; call search_trips again or suggest alternatives.
- status "invalid_input" (INVALID_INPUT): the vehicleType or a stop does not belong to that offer, or a customStops place could not be resolved; the message says what to fix.

Stops: pass availableStops entries as stops (price is known from the search) or other places as customStops (re-priced). The returned price is the total including stops.

Nothing is reserved or charged by this tool: the booking exists only once the traveler pays on the website. Never mention ids, tool names or internal steps to the traveler. Each call creates a new booking draft; call it once per confirmed choice.

adults.description: Number of adult passengers, including the lead traveler.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code to show the price in as well; use the one from search_trips.

customStops.description: Stops at places not in availableStops. The trip is then routed and priced through them, so the price will differ from the search.

locale.description: Language of the traveler's pages and emails (en, de, es, fr, pt).

offerId.description: offerId of the chosen search_trips option.

stops.description: Sightseeing stops from the search's availableStops the customer wants to add, in any order.

durationMinutes.description: Time at the stop; defaults to the stop's defaultDurationMinutes.

locationId.description: locationId of an availableStops entry from search_trips.

vehicleType.description: vehicle.type of the chosen search_trips option (a class identifier such as sedan or van).

name: get_booking_link
title: Prepare a Daytrip booking on daytrip.com (handover link)
